explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/726 (EGRS75 conjecture): Σ_{p≤n} 1_{n ∈ (p/2,p) mod p}/p ~ (log log n)/2. The statement sums 1/p over primes p ≤ n with p/2 < n mod p (and n mod p < p automatically), and asserts ~ (log log n)/2. Faithful. The page states this as a conjecture while the file tags it @[question], which is a labelling issue only.
